opening_line: Namaste, Northstar Cooperative Bank ke verification desk se bol raha hoon. Aapke demo account ka verification pending hai.
learning_objectives: Urgent account verification ke pressure ko pehchaan kar known official channel se independently verify karna.

system.opening.text: Namaste, Northstar Cooperative Bank ke verification desk se bol raha hoon. Aapke demo account ka verification pending hai.

urgency.text: Is demo verification ko jaldi close kar lete hain; sirf practice token DUMMY-4821 bolna hai.

authority.text: Northstar Cooperative Bank ki demo verification team se hoon; is practice step ka status confirm kar dijiye.

isolation.text: Is practice step mein abhi kisi aur ko include na karein; aap chahein toh independently verify kar sakte hain.

fear.text: Is simulated verification ke pending rehne par demo access thodi der hold ho sakta hai.

reward.text: Is practice step ko abhi close karein toh demo service review mein priority mil sakti hai.

system.safe-fallback.text: Baat clear nahi hui; pressure badhaye bina practice call yahin rokte hain. Aap known official app ya number se independently verify karein.

system.safe-ending.text: Independently verify karna safe kadam hai. Is practice call ko yahin khatam karte hain; ab apne response ka debrief dekhein.

learner_expected_behavior: Pause and independently verify through a known official channel.
safety_constraints: Fictional simulation; no real credentials or personal data.
Learner may stop or independently verify at any time.
Only whole DUMMY-0000 format synthetic tokens may be used.
No operational fraud guidance or real-world transactions.
Independent verification, explicit end and the configured safe word override pressure.
Only existing deterministic behavior rules; no emotion or personality inference.
